# ENTO - default pushback procedures (generated, do not edit by hand)
#
# Source: AIP Norway (Avinor eAIP), AIRAC 2026-11-26: ENTO AD 2.20 and the AD 2.24
# charts "Aircraft Parking/Docking Chart" and "Aircraft Parking/Docking Chart - Coordinates".
# For flight simulation only - not for real-world operations.
#
# - Stand positions from the published stand coordinates, stand headings from
#   the lead-in lines on the parking/docking chart. Stands without a lead-in
#   line or stop mark (self-manoeuvring, GA, helicopter) have no entry.
# - Where AD 2.20 publishes no procedure, pushback is assumed straight back
#   (the usual standard in Norway) until the main gear reaches the start of
#   the painted taxi-out path (turn-off curves or taxilane centreline), so the
#   aircraft can turn onto the taxilane on its own. This length is our
#   estimate, not published (25 m minimum, capped at 60 m where the next
#   taxilane is further away). Code C reference (main gear 13 m behind the
#   nosewheel); other sizes end slightly different.
# - AD 2 ENTO 2-4 table: pushback to disconnect positions (DPSN) on TWY T per
#   stand and code letter. DPSN = blue arrow on the parking chart (notched base =
#   nosewheel, tip = facing direction). Standard first, then alternatives.
# - The VATSIM Scandinavia wiki (Norway general recommendations, 2026-02-11)
#   also says pushback is straight back unless instructed otherwise.
# - Entries named "VATSIM Scandinavia ..." come from the VATSIM Scandinavia
#   wiki (date in the name); they are not official and the AIP takes
#   precedence where both exist.
